from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class HousingReport(BaseModel):
    """A single month's housing starts statistics from a specific press release."""
    statistical_month: str | None = Field(description="The month the statistics cover, e.g. '2022-08'")
    release_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the report was released, used to resolve conflicting values")
    mom_change_percent: float | None = Field(description="The explicitly stated month-over-month percentage change")
    saar_current: float | None = Field(description="The Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for the statistical month")
    saar_previous: float | None = Field(description="The SAAR for the previous month, used if mom_change_percent is unavailable")
    metric_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of housing starts reported, e.g. 'total' or 'privately-owned'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    housing_reports: list[HousingReport]
